_about: Press, reviews, listings and coverage of Doug Rosenberg himself as a leader or sideman, outside Eastern Blok (see eastern-blok-press.json for the band). Same schema as press/SCHEMA.md. entries.title: Bob Moses
entries.provenance: Found 2026-10-23 through the Reader's WordPress API (search "Bob Moses"). Critic's Choice blurb: the drummer Bob Moses, teaching at the New England Conservatory, plays Fri-Sat April 2-3, 2004, 9:30 PM, at the Velvet Lounge with Doug Rosenberg, with a drum clinic at Rhythm on April 4. The same week's listing (trg-music-listings-15) reads "Bob Moses (see Critic's Choice) & Doug Rosenberg".

entries.title: TRG Music Listings: Doug Rosenberg Trio at Montage, Naperville
entries.provenance: Found 2026-10-23 through the Reader's WordPress API (search "Doug Rosenberg"). Weekly listing "MONTAGE 3124 S. Rte. 59, Naperville: Fridays and Saturdays, 8 PM, Doug Rosenberg Trio" from trg-music-listings-46 (2003-02-27, with Kyle Asche and Clark Sommers on Fri 2/28 and Mike Allemana and Lorin Cohen on Sat 3/1) through trg-music-listings-6 (2004-01-29), Saturdays only after about 2003-07. About 48 weekly listings, i.e. a residency of roughly a year. Name only; confirm this is the same Doug Rosenberg.

entries.title: TRG Music Listings: Keyon Harrold/Doug Rosenberg Quintet, Chase Cafe
entries.provenance: Found 2026-10-23: "CHASE CAFE 7301 N. Sheridan: Thu 5/8, 7 PM, Keyon Harrold/Doug Rosenberg Quintet, Organic Mind Unit." Listing text only; confirm the same Doug.

entries.title: chi.now&then, April-June 2003: Doug Rosenberg with Keyon Harrold and Robert Glasper
entries.notes: Three listings: Wed May 7, 5 PM, "Doug Rosenberg w/ Keyon Harrold & Robert Glasper" at Jazz Record Mart (free); Wed May 7, 9 PM, "Doug Rosenberg/Keyon Harrold Quintet w/ Robert Glasper" at the Velvet Lounge ($10); Thu May 8, 7 PM, "Organic Mind Unit - Doug Rosenberg, Keyon Harrold, Robert Glasper" at Chase Cafe. The Reader listed the Chase Cafe night as "Keyon Harrold/Doug Rosenberg Quintet" (chireader-trg-chase-cafe-2003-05). The same page lists "Douglas Rosenberg" in the 17-piece Live the Spirit Band (Ernest Dawkins) at the Green Mill on Sat May 17; not confirmed to be Doug, so not claimed. Calendar page, not a review; issue date not on the page.

entries.title: chi.now&then, July-September 2003: Douglas Rosenberg Quintet at the Velvet Lounge
entries.notes: Thu July 17, 10 PM, and Wed Aug 27, 9:30 PM (listed under the Jazz Institute's Jazz Club Tour, $20), "Douglas Rosenberg Quintet" at the Velvet Lounge. Billed "Douglas", not "Doug"; the same page also lists Scott Rosenberg (reeds), a different musician. Confirm these are Doug's quintet.

entries.title: chi.now&then, October-December 2003: Doug Rosenberg at the Hungry Brain
entries.notes: Sun Nov 16, 10 PM, Hungry Brain, "Doug Rosenberg, Andre Beasly, Bryan Nichols, TBA". The same page lists Scott Rosenberg at the Velvet Lounge on Nov 7, a different musician.

entries.notes: Fri April 2 and Sat April 3, 2004, 10 PM, $10, "Bob Moses & Doug Rosenberg" at the Velvet Lounge. Same shows as the Reader Critic's Choice and the jazzreview.com concert review.

unfetchedLeads.note: The Chicago Tribune quote in Doug's bio ("fearlessness of spirit and a robustness of tone...") has no located source. Tribune is blocked to the search tool and DuckDuckGo found nothing 2026-10-23. Ask Doug who wrote it and roughly when.

gaps: No independent review of Better Than TV (2013-14) found as of 2026-10-23: WBEZ, All Souls, Boo Boo and Amazon/Apple/eBay pages are listings or retail copy.
Doug-led shows after 2004 (Quintet 2007+, Quartet 2013) are known only from venue and radio pages; the Reader's website keeps nothing after 2004 for them.
St. Louis: no 2003 or other Doug-led St. Louis coverage found. Eastern Blok's St. Louis dates (2007-11-03, 2008-10-11, 2009-08-28) are in eastern-blok-press.json.
